Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing a population sustainability element for comprehensive plans under the growth management act.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to authorizing a population sustainability elementfor comprehensive plans under the growth management act; and amendingRCW 36.70A.080.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 36.70A.080 and 1990 1st ex.s. c 17 s 8 are eachamended to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A comprehensive plan may include additional elements, items, orstudies dealing with other subjects relating to the physicaldevelopment within its jurisdiction, including, but not limited to: (a) Conservation; (b) Solar energy; ((and)) (c) Recreation; and (d) Population sustainability. (2) A comprehensive plan may include, where appropriate, subareaplans, each of which is consistent with the comprehensive plan. (3) A population sustainability element must include provisions forpublic education and outreach. Public education and outreachprovisions may include developing educational materials emphasizing the p. 1 HB 3121benefits and importance of considering population sustainability andfamily planning within the context of land use decisions.
